capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database Panasonic 2170L pack: 82.0 kWh nominal; evspecifications 2021 North American LR AWD: 82.1 kWh. Carried over from the 2021 Fremont-built car (non-import NRCan/EPA rating). DOUBT: the NRCan/EPA range drops 576 to 536 km for 2023 (EPA 358 to 333 mi when Tesla re-introduced the LR AWD in spring 2023); InsideEVs speculated this implies a different pack, and an EPA methodology change is the other explanation. No source confirms either; the pack may instead be the LG NMC 78.1/75 (as for the Canadian import car). EU cars of 2022-23 used the LG 78.1 kWh pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2023 LR AWD). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.
